questions.stem_text:
Which of the following sites has monumental earthworks with concentric ridges in a
semicircle that date from around 3,500 years ago?

Indus Valley civilization is unmatched in comparison to other early civilizations in terms
of what?

options.A: the height and size of its monumental architecture
options.B: the amount and frequency of violence
options.D: the amount of surplus wheat that was produced for storage

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - the degree of urban planning

questions.stem_text:
What is the name of the lithic technology seen in the Arctic and consisting of wedge-
shaped cores, micro-blades, bifacial knives, and burins?
Homo erectus differed from Homo habilis in which way?

options.A: Erectus fossils are found only in Africa.
options.D: Erectus was a relatively short-lived species.

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - Erectus possessed a larger brain.

questions.stem_text:
In Randall White's view, what do items of personal adornment imply during the Upper
Paleolithic period?

options.A: a willingness to travel great distances
options.B: a hobby done around the campfire at night
options.C: increasing awareness and importance of individual identity
options.D: greater intelligence and willingness to cooperate

questions.answer_explanation: Correct option: C - increasing awareness and importance of individual identity
